sections.instruction: Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d:

items.question: We ................ with our ears.
items.explanation_ar: نسمع بالأذنين، لذلك نستخدم hear. العينان للرؤية واللسان للتذوق.
items.explanation_en: We hear with the ears, so we use hear. The eyes are for seeing and the tongue is for tasting.

items.question: I can ................ soft things with my fingers.
items.explanation_ar: الجملة تتكلم عن الإحساس بالملمس بالأصابع، لذلك نختار touch.
items.explanation_en: The sentence talks about feeling texture with the fingers, so we choose touch.

items.question: You use your ................ to read a book.
items.explanation_ar: نستخدم العينين في القراءة، لذلك الإجابة eyes.
items.explanation_en: We use the eyes for reading, so the answer is eyes.

items.question: If we smell smoke, we know there's a ................ .
items.explanation_ar: رائحة الدخان علامة على وجود حريق، لذلك الإجابة fire.
items.explanation_en: The smell of smoke is a sign of a fire, so the answer is fire.

items.question: I can ................ the ice cream with my tongue.
items.explanation_ar: اللسان للتذوق، لذلك الفعل المناسب taste.
items.explanation_en: The tongue is for tasting, so the suitable verb is taste.

items.question: She ................ her teeth every morning.
items.explanation_ar: مع She في المضارع البسيط نضيف es إلى brush، فتصبح brushes.
items.explanation_en: With She in the present simple we add es to brush, so it becomes brushes.

items.question: My grandfather ................ coffee in the morning.
items.explanation_ar: My grandfather مفرد، لذلك نضيف s إلى drink في المضارع البسيط: drinks.
items.explanation_en: My grandfather is singular, so we add s to drink in the present simple: drinks.

items.question: Salma and I ................ the school bus every day.
items.explanation_ar: Salma and I تعني we، لذلك نستخدم الفعل الأساسي take من غير s.
items.explanation_en: Salma and I means we, so we use the base verb take with no s.

items.question: Sleeping early keeps me ................ .
items.explanation_ar: بعد keeps me نحتاج صفة تصف حالتي، وhealthy معناها بصحة جيدة.
items.explanation_en: After keeps me we need an adjective that describes my state, and healthy means بصحة جيدة.

items.question: I ................ a shower in the evening.
items.explanation_ar: التعبير الصحيح للاستحمام هو take a shower.
items.explanation_en: The correct expression for bathing is take a shower.

items.question: He ................ stories in English class.
items.explanation_ar: مع He في المضارع البسيط نضيف s إلى read، فتصبح reads.
items.explanation_en: With He in the present simple we add s to read, so it becomes reads.

items.question: A healthy lunch has rice, chicken, vegetables and ................ .
items.explanation_ar: fruit معناها فاكهة، وهي تكمل مكونات الوجبة الصحية المذكورة.
items.explanation_en: fruit means فاكهة, and it completes the ingredients of the healthy meal mentioned.

items.question: First, I wake up. ................ , I brush my teeth.
items.explanation_ar: Then معناها بعد ذلك، وتأتي لذكر الخطوة التالية بعد First.
items.explanation_en: Then means بعد ذلك, and it comes to mention the next step after First.

items.question: Goha gave the owner the ................ of his coins.
items.explanation_ar: Goha مدفعش فلوس، دفع صوت فلوسه، لأن صاحب المطعم قاله لازم تدفع تمن الريحة. sound هو الاختيار في القصة.
items.explanation_en: In the story Goha paid with the sound of his coins, because the owner said he had to pay for the smell.

items.question: Milk and fruit give me ................ for the day.
items.explanation_ar: energy معناها طاقة، وهي ما يمدنا به الطعام خلال اليوم.
items.explanation_en: energy means طاقة, and it is what food gives us during the day.

items.question: We ................ TV together in the evening.
items.explanation_ar: التعبير الصحيح لمشاهدة التلفاز هو watch TV. ومع We نستخدم watch من غير s.
items.explanation_en: The correct expression for watching TV is watch TV. And with We we use watch with no s.

items.question: I ................ trash from the garden.
items.explanation_ar: collect trash معناها نجمع القمامة، وهو التعبير المناسب لتنظيف الحديقة.
items.explanation_en: collect trash means نجمع القمامة, and it is the suitable expression for cleaning the park.

items.question: It's good to ................ food with friends.
items.explanation_ar: share food معناها نتشارك الطعام مع الآخرين.
items.explanation_en: share food means نتشارك الطعام مع الآخرين.

items.question: You should throw trash in the ................ .
items.explanation_ar: bin معناها سلة القمامة، وهي المكان المناسب لرمي المخلفات.
items.explanation_en: bin means سلة القمامة, and it is the right place to throw waste.

items.question: It's ................ to smoke here.
items.grading_reason: السياق لا يحدد إجابة واحدة مؤكدة. يُراجع مع المدرس ولا يدخل في الدرجة.
items.explanation_ar: مفيش إجابة واحدة مؤكدة للسؤال ده، فراجعه مع المدرس.
items.explanation_en: This item has no single confirmed answer, so check it with your teacher.

items.question: ................ you study English every day?
items.explanation_ar: مع you في سؤال المضارع البسيط نبدأ بـ Do ثم الفاعل ثم الفعل الأساسي.
items.explanation_en: With you in a present simple question we start with Do, then the subject, then the base verb.

items.question: ................ Heba like ice cream?
items.explanation_ar: Heba مفرد، لذلك نبدأ السؤال بـ Does، ويأتي like بعدها من غير s.
items.explanation_en: Heba is singular, so we start the question with Does, and like comes after it with no s.

items.question: He ................ go to school on Friday.
items.explanation_ar: مع He ننفي المضارع البسيط باستخدام does not أو doesn’t، وبعدها الفعل الأساسي go.
items.explanation_en: With He we make the present simple negative with does not or doesn’t, followed by the base verb go.

items.question: We ................ play football on Friday.
items.explanation_ar: مع We ننفي المضارع البسيط باستخدام do not أو don’t، وبعدها الفعل الأساسي play.
items.explanation_en: With We we make the present simple negative with do not or don’t, followed by the base verb play.

items.question: The bus helps ................ traffic.
items.explanation_ar: reduce traffic معناها يقلل الزحام، لأن الحافلة تنقل أشخاصًا كثيرين معًا.
items.explanation_en: reduce traffic means يقلل الزحام, because the bus carries many people together.

items.question: Many people like to ................ at the community park.
items.grading_reason: السياق لا يحدد إجابة واحدة مؤكدة. يُراجع مع المدرس ولا يدخل في الدرجة.
items.explanation_ar: مفيش إجابة واحدة مؤكدة للسؤال ده، فراجعه مع المدرس.
items.explanation_en: This item has no single confirmed answer, so check it with your teacher.

items.question: Cars ................ slowly in the morning.
items.explanation_ar: Cars جمع، فنستخدم الفعل المصدر move من غير s.
items.explanation_en: Cars is plural, so we use the base verb move with no s.

items.question: According to the textbook: In Upper Egypt, farmers grow ................ .
items.explanation_ar: حسب الكتاب، في صعيد مصر المزارعين بيزرعوا sugar cane يعني قصب السكر.
items.explanation_en: According to the textbook, farmers in Upper Egypt grow sugar cane.

items.question: Men in Upper Egypt wear ................ .
items.explanation_ar: حسب الدرس، الرجالة في الصعيد بيلبسوا galabeyas يعني جلاليب.
items.explanation_en: In the lesson, men in Upper Egypt wear galabeyas.

items.question: We can take a train from the ................ .
items.explanation_ar: بنركب القطر من train station يعني محطة القطر.
items.explanation_en: We take a train from the train station.

items.question: My mother told me ................ about her family.
items.explanation_ar: الأم بتحكي stories يعني حكايات عن عيلتها.
items.explanation_en: A mother tells stories about her family.

items.question: ................ to school to stop air pollution.
items.explanation_ar: Walk to school معناها امشي للمدرسة، وده بيقلل تلوث الهوا لأن العربيات بتتوقف.
items.explanation_en: Walk to school is a way to stop air pollution because fewer cars are used.

items.question: Elephants need ................ spaces than monkeys.
items.explanation_ar: Elephants أكبر من القرود، فهي محتاجة مساحة bigger يعني أكبر. بعد need spaces than بنستخدم المقارنة.
items.explanation_en: Elephants are bigger than monkeys, so they need bigger spaces. The sentence has than, so we use the comparative.

items.question: Giraffes need ................ trees than other animals.
items.explanation_ar: الزرافة طويلة، فمحتاجة شجر taller يعني أطول. بعد than بنستخدم المقارنة.
items.explanation_en: Giraffes are tall, so they need taller trees. The sentence has than, so we use the comparative.

items.question: The ................ is black and white.
items.explanation_ar: الحيوان الأبيض والأسود هو zebra يعني الحمار الوحشي.
items.explanation_en: The black and white animal is the zebra.

items.question: Monkeys are very good at ................ trees.
items.explanation_ar: بعد good at بنستخدم الفعل + ing: climbing.
items.explanation_en: After good at we use verb + ing: climbing.

items.question: The cat is ................ than the mouse.
items.explanation_ar: في الجملة than، فنستخدم المقارنة bigger.
items.explanation_en: The sentence has than, so we use the comparative: bigger.

items.question: Noha is ................ than Nashwa.
items.explanation_ar: في الجملة than، فنستخدم المقارنة shorter.
items.explanation_en: The sentence has than, so we use the comparative: shorter.

items.question: According to the textbook: Pets need ................ care from their owners.
items.explanation_ar: حسب الكتاب، الحيوانات الأليفة محتاجة رعاية daily يعني كل يوم.
items.explanation_en: According to the textbook, pets need care daily, which means every day.

items.question: In the story, the old lion ................ to be sick.
items.explanation_ar: القصة حصلت في الماضي، فنستخدم pretended (ماضي pretend) مع to be sick.
items.explanation_en: The story is in the past, so we use pretended (past of pretend).

items.question: The clever fox saw the one-way ................ .
items.explanation_ar: الثعلب الذكي شاف footprints يعني آثار أقدام في اتجاه واحد، وده اللي كشف الخدعة.
items.explanation_en: The clever fox saw one-way footprints, which showed the trick.

items.question: Giraffes eat green ................ .
items.explanation_ar: الزرافة بتاكل leaves يعني ورق شجر أخضر.
items.explanation_en: Giraffes eat green leaves.

items.question: A ................ is a doctor who takes care of sick animals.
items.explanation_ar: vet هو دكتور بيعالج الحيوانات المريضة.
items.explanation_en: A vet is a doctor who takes care of sick animals.

items.question: Fruit is ................ than sweets.
items.explanation_ar: في الجملة than، فنستخدم المقارنة healthier.
items.explanation_en: The sentence has than, so we use the comparative: healthier.

items.question: The plane is ................ than the train.
items.explanation_ar: في الجملة than، فنستخدم المقارنة faster.
items.explanation_en: The sentence has than, so we use the comparative: faster.

items.question: The ................ is a very long river in Egypt.
items.explanation_ar: the Nile هو نهر النيل، أطول نهر في مصر.
items.explanation_en: The Nile is a very long river in Egypt.

items.question: According to the tour-guide text, tourists ride ................ near the Pyramids.
items.explanation_ar: حسب نص المرشد السياحي، السياح بيركبوا camels يعني جمال جنب الأهرامات.
items.explanation_en: According to the tour-guide text, tourists ride camels near the Pyramids.

items.question: People buy gifts from the ................ .
items.explanation_ar: بنشتري الهدايا من bazaar يعني السوق.
items.explanation_en: People buy gifts from the bazaar.

items.question: An ................ is a place with water and trees in the desert.
items.explanation_ar: oasis هي مكان فيه ميه وشجر في الصحرا.
items.explanation_en: An oasis is a place with water and trees in the desert.

items.question: You can look down at Cairo from the Cairo ................ .
items.explanation_ar: من Cairo Tower يعني برج القاهرة تقدر تبص على القاهرة من فوق.
items.explanation_en: From the Cairo Tower you can look down at Cairo.

items.question: The flower is growing ................ the pot.
items.explanation_ar: in معناها جوه، والوردة بتنمو جوه الإصيص.
items.explanation_en: In means inside; the flower grows in the pot.

items.question: The bank is ................ the post office and the school.
items.explanation_ar: between معناها بين اتنين، والبنك بين مكتب البريد والمدرسة.
items.explanation_en: Between is used for something in the middle of two places: the bank is between the post office and the school.

items.question: The picture is ................ the wall.
items.explanation_ar: on معناها على السطح، والصورة متعلقة على الحيطة.
items.explanation_en: On means touching a surface: the picture is on the wall.

items.question: 1,000,000,000 is one ................ .
items.explanation_ar: 1,000,000,000 بنقرأها one billion يعني مليار.
items.explanation_en: 1,000,000,000 is read one billion.

items.question: 560,000 is five hundred and sixty ................ .
items.explanation_ar: 560,000 بنقرأها five hundred and sixty thousand يعني ألف.
items.explanation_en: 560,000 is read five hundred and sixty thousand.

items.question: St. Catherine Mountain is in ................ .
items.explanation_ar: St. Catherine Mountain موجود في South Sinai يعني جنوب سيناء.
items.explanation_en: St. Catherine Mountain is in South Sinai.

items.question: Siwa Oasis is famous for sweet ................ .
items.explanation_ar: واحة سيوة مشهورة بـ dates يعني بلح حلو.
items.explanation_en: Siwa Oasis is famous for sweet dates.

items.question: Tourists ................ photos of the museum.
items.explanation_ar: بنقول take photos يعني نصوّر.
items.explanation_en: The collocation is take photos.

items.question: A ................ stops fires and saves people.
items.explanation_ar: firefighter هو اللي بيطفي الحرايق وبينقذ الناس.
items.explanation_en: A firefighter stops fires and saves people.

items.question: An ................ designs new buildings.
items.explanation_ar: engineer هو اللي بيصمم المباني الجديدة.
items.explanation_en: An engineer designs new buildings.

items.question: The doctor works in a ................ .
items.explanation_ar: الدكتور بيشتغل في hospital يعني مستشفى.
items.explanation_en: A doctor works in a hospital.

items.question: According to the doctor text, Sara helps ................ people.
items.explanation_ar: حسب نص الدكتورة، Sara بتساعد sick people يعني الناس المرضى.
items.explanation_en: According to the doctor text, Sara helps sick people.

items.question: This is the ................ tree in the garden.
items.explanation_ar: قبل the بنستخدم صيغة التفضيل: tallest.
items.explanation_en: After the we use the superlative: tallest.

items.question: The elephant is the ................ animal in the zoo.
items.explanation_ar: قبل the بنستخدم صيغة التفضيل: biggest.
items.explanation_en: After the we use the superlative: biggest.

items.question: August is the ................ month of the year.
items.explanation_ar: قبل the بنستخدم صيغة التفضيل: hottest.
items.explanation_en: After the we use the superlative: hottest.

items.question: My grandpa is the ................ person I know.
items.explanation_ar: قبل the بنستخدم صيغة التفضيل: wisest.
items.explanation_en: After the we use the superlative: wisest.

items.question: Amr is a wildlife ................ who loves taking pictures.
items.explanation_ar: wildlife photographer هو مصور الحياة البرية اللي بيحب التصوير.
items.explanation_en: A wildlife photographer takes pictures of wild animals.

items.question: A mentor ................ children learn.
items.explanation_ar: mentor فاعل مفرد في المضارع البسيط، فنستخدم helps بـ s.
items.explanation_en: Mentor is singular in the present simple, so we use helps with s.

items.question: Voice-over actors make ................ for cartoons.
items.explanation_ar: Voice-over actors بيعملوا voices يعني أصوات للكرتون.
items.explanation_en: Voice-over actors make voices for cartoons.

items.question: Sami was a skilled ................ . He built strong houses.
items.explanation_ar: carpenter هو النجار، وده اللي بيبني بيوت قوية حسب الجملة.
items.explanation_en: A carpenter builds strong things; the sentence says Sami built strong houses.

items.question: Wanda always wore the same ................ dress.
items.explanation_ar: في القصة Wanda كانت دايما بتلبس نفس الفستان blue يعني الأزرق.
items.explanation_en: In the story Wanda always wore the same blue dress.

items.question: Wanda said she had a ................ dresses in her closet.
items.explanation_ar: Wanda قالت إن عندها hundred يعني مية فستان في الدولاب.
items.explanation_en: Wanda said she had a hundred dresses in her closet.

items.question: Wanda ................ to the big city with her family.
items.explanation_ar: في القصة Wanda moved يعني انتقلت للمدينة الكبيرة مع عيلتها.
items.explanation_en: In the story Wanda moved to the big city with her family.

items.question: ................ won the drawing competition.
items.explanation_ar: اللي كسبت مسابقة الرسم هي Wanda حسب القصة.
items.explanation_en: According to the story, Wanda won the drawing competition.

items.question: Peggy and Maddie wrote a ................ to Wanda.
items.explanation_ar: Peggy وMaddie كتبوا letter يعني جواب لـ Wanda.
items.explanation_en: Peggy and Maddie wrote a letter to Wanda.

items.question: Wanda's father sent a letter to ................ .
items.explanation_ar: مفيش إجابة واحدة مؤكدة للسؤال ده، فراجعه مع المدرس.
items.explanation_en: This item has no single confirmed answer, so check it with your teacher.

items.question: Wanda was ................ at her new school.
items.explanation_ar: مفيش إجابة واحدة مؤكدة للسؤال ده، فراجعه مع المدرس.
items.explanation_en: This item has no single confirmed answer, so check it with your teacher.

sections.instruction: Read and complete the text with the words in the box:

items.text: I see with my eyes. I hear with my (1) ................ . I (2) ................ with my nose. I taste with my (3) ................ . I touch with my (4) ................ . These five (5) ................ help me understand the world around me.

items.explanation_en: Read the whole text first. Each word from the box fits the meaning and grammar of its gap. Answers: 1) ears | 2) smell | 3) tongue | 4) hands | 5) senses

items.text: My brother and I have healthy habits. He wakes up early and (1) ................ his teeth. Then he eats (2) ................ . After school, he (3) ................ our father at home. Her mother says it is important to eat from all (3) ................ groups. Sara drinks (4) ................ , too. She feels strong and full of (5) ................ .

items.explanation_en: Read the whole text first. Each word from the box fits the meaning and grammar of its gap. Answers: 1) problems | 2) move | 3) near | 4) buses | 5) cars

items.text: Hassan is in grade four. He likes to (1) ................ in his community park. On Fridays, he and his friends (2) ................ the park and (3) ................ bottles and cans. They also (4) ................ trees and flowers. Hassan feels very (5) ................ when his community is clean.
